title: Angry Birds: Summer Madness
overview: Teen birds Red, Chuck, Bomb and Stella are crashing through Camp Splinterwood with their fellow feathered campers for a summer of high-flying hijinks!

title: Brown and Friends
overview: In a cozy little neighborhood coffee shop, a group of fun-loving friends get together — and get up to all kinds of adventures.

title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
overview: A group of lovable, huggable BFFs go on adventures and live that sweet Care Bear life. When a new adventure takes them to a strange new world, the bears have to lean on each other more than ever. Through friendship, courage and a little belly badge magic, the Care Bears continue their mission to spread caring and sharing to the world.

title: Dog Days Out
overview: When their humans are away, a cute and curious pup and his dog pals love to play with their best friends — their favorite toys!

title: Furry Friends Forever: Elmo Gets a Puppy
overview: An upcoming animated Sesame Street special premiering on HBO Max on August 5, 2021. The special serves as an introduction to Tango, Elmo's new pet puppy.

title: My Little Pony: Tell Your Tale
overview: The Mane 5 are back! Sunny teams up with her pony pals for more adventures as they live, learn and laugh together in Maretime Bay.

title: Oggy Oggy
overview: Join adorable kitten Oggy and his cast of cat pals in a bright and colorful kitty world. They're always on the go for fun times and fantastic adventures!

title: Phantom Pups
overview: A young boy and his family move into a haunted home, where he meets three adorable ghost pups and tries to help them turn back into real dogs.

title: Ridley Jones
overview: Curious kid Ridley and her friends protect the Museum of Natural History’s treasures and keep its magical secret safe: Everything comes alive at night!

title: Scaredy Cats
overview: On Willa Ward’s twelfth birthday, she inherits a beautiful charm necklace that belonged to her mother, who was a witch.  She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

title: Karate Sheep
overview: Trico is an enthusiastic sheep who loves to share new objects and ideas with the rest of the flock. This causes ruckus in the mountain pastures, which all inevitably end up at Wanda’s expense, a tough ewe whose job is to keep the sheep safe. Not a small feat, especially when Wolf is always lurking, waiting to make the most of this newfound chaos.

title: Larva Family
overview: The Larva family is growing! When Red and Yellow welcome a baby caterpillar into their lives, they get a crash course in parenting and all things putrid.

title: Larva in Mars
overview: Landing on Mars after a silly mishap, goofy larva friends Red and Yellow encounter curious Martians — and a sinister secret.

title: Larva Island
overview: Stranded on a tropical island, two silly larva buddies find slapstick fun in everything from discovering food to meeting new animal friends.
